rituals.title: WORD MELT
rituals.name: WORD MELT
rituals.hook: Try: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
rituals.hook_internal: Try: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Choose Charged → Listen Moment → Return Seen
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Choose Charged → Listen Moment → Return Seen
rituals.goal: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
rituals.mission: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
rituals.challenge: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
rituals.immediate_need: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Charged — Choose one charged word—not a whole painful story. Word Melt — loosen hands.
2. Say Gently — Say it gently and steadily for about twenty seconds.
3. Listen Moment — Listen for the moment it becomes rhythm, mouth movement, or noise. Word Melt — notice detail.
4. Stop Room — Stop there and look around the room.
5. Return Seen — Meaning may return; you have seen it separate once. Word Melt — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Return Seen.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
rituals.formula_flow: Choose Charged → Say Gently → Listen Moment → Stop Room → Return Seen
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid this with slurs, trauma phrases, voices, or material that escalates symptoms.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: SET THE CONVERSATION SIZE
rituals.name: SET THE CONVERSATION SIZE
rituals.hook: Imagine: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.hook_internal: Imagine: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Read Bandwidth → Send Signal → Set Reopen
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Read Bandwidth → Send Signal → Set Reopen
rituals.goal: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.mission: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.challenge: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.immediate_need: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Communication & conflict

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Read Bandwidth — Choose your current safe bandwidth: ONE SENTENCE, THREE SENTENCES, or FULL CONVERSATION. Set Conversation — loosen hands.
2. Choose Size — Name the purpose that must fit inside that size: acknowledge, request, pause, clarify, or repair.
3. Send Signal — Draft or say only the selected amount. Stop when the sentence limit is reached, even if more remains. Set Conversation — estimate odds.
4. Set Reopen — Name when or under what condition the next level can reopen. If you cannot offer one, state that honestly without making a false promise. Set Conversation — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Set Reopen.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.formula_flow: Read Bandwidth → Choose Size → Send Signal → Set Reopen
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Do not use bandwidth limits to conceal immediate danger, threats, abuse, medical urgency, or information another person needs for safety.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: THEN / NOW SUBTITLES
rituals.name: THEN / NOW SUBTITLES
rituals.hook: Probe: Flashbacks need temporal translation.
rituals.hook_internal: Probe: Flashbacks need temporal translation.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Alternate Lines → Keep Eyes → Date Location
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Alternate Lines → Keep Eyes → Date Location
rituals.goal: Flashbacks need temporal translation.
rituals.mission: Flashbacks need temporal translation.
rituals.challenge: Flashbacks need temporal translation.
rituals.immediate_need: Flashbacks need temporal translation.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Trauma & memory-as-present

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Flashbacks need temporal translation.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Alternate Lines — When memory body alarm begins, alternate lines: THEN—state one past fact; NOW—state one current difference. Now Subtitles — hear sound.
2. Include Age — Include age, place, available help, bodily freedom, and exits.
3. Keep Eyes — Keep eyes open and touch the environment after every pair. Now Subtitles — notice detail.
4. Date Location — The screen may replay; the subtitles restore date and location. Now Subtitles — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Date Location.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ That was then. I found something that is true now.

rituals.title: CHANGE ONE THING, WATCH ONE FEELING
rituals.name: CHANGE ONE THING, WATCH ONE FEELING
rituals.ritual_name: CHANGE ONE THING, WATCH ONE FEELING
rituals.hook: Watch: Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.
rituals.hook_internal: Watch: Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Pair → Swap Variable → Tag Driver
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Name Pair → Swap Variable → Tag Driver
rituals.goal: Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.
rituals.mission: Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.
rituals.challenge: Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.
rituals.immediate_need: Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Pair — Name two emotions in the mixture and rate each with a simple low, medium, or high—not a number. Change Thing — widen gaze.
2. Hold Scene — Hold the scene steady. Choose only one variable to test: person, time, place, audience, or outcome.
3. Swap Variable — Imagine that one variable changed for ten seconds. Keep every other fact the same. Change Thing — name feeling.
4. Tag Driver — Notice which emotion moved and which stayed. Tag the changed variable as a likely driver, not a final explanation. Change Thing — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Tag Driver.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.
rituals.formula_flow: Name Pair → Hold Scene → Swap Variable → Tag Driver
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Do not use imagined substitutions to rewrite trauma, deny facts, or continue once the scene becomes overwhelming or unreal.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

GOAL
Give both positions a voice without claiming either is fact.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Place Chairs — Place two chairs apart. Two Chairs — soften shoulders.
2. Speak Position — Speak from your position using first person.
3. Switch Chair — Move and answer as the other position, labelling imagination where knowledge is missing. Two Chairs — notice detail.
4. Return To Facts — Return to your chair and state what changed, what did not, and what real conversation may still be needed. Two Chairs — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Return To Facts.

rituals.title: MAKE FEAR NAME A DEADLINE
rituals.name: MAKE FEAR NAME A DEADLINE
rituals.hook: Test: A warning must become testable before it can command you.
rituals.hook_internal: Test: A warning must become testable before it can command you.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Pin Forecast → Score Odds → Update Odds
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Pin Forecast → Score Odds → Update Odds
rituals.goal: A warning must become testable before it can command you.
rituals.mission: A warning must become testable before it can command you.
rituals.challenge: A warning must become testable before it can command you.
rituals.immediate_need: A warning must become testable before it can command you.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A warning must become testable before it can command you.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Pin Forecast — Restate the fear as one visible or audible forecast—not a vague catastrophe. Make Fear — move slowly.
2. Set Clock — Give the forecast a real time window.
3. Score Odds — Set confidence on a 0–100 scale before checking anything. Make Fear — find evidence.
4. Observe Safely — Use only a naturally occurring safe observation; never manufacture a test.
5. Update Odds — Hold the result and update confidence in either direction. Make Fear — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Update Odds.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ A warning must become testable before it can command you.
rituals.formula_flow: Pin Forecast → Set Clock → Score Odds → Observe Safely → Update Odds
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Do not test danger, invade privacy, or repeat the observation to chase certainty.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.goal: Rotate before one cue becomes background noise.

rituals.challenge: Rotate before one cue becomes background noise.
rituals.immediate_need: Rotate before one cue becomes background noise.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Rotate before one cue becomes background noise.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Select Different — Select four anchors from different systems: visual line, distant sound, contact pressure, joint position. Grounding Anchor — hear sound.
2. Switch Getting — Spend a short interval with each and switch before getting used to it empties it. Grounding Anchor — notice detail.
3. Finish Channel — Finish on the channel that restored the clearest present contact. Grounding Anchor — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Channel.

rituals.hook: Shift: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.hook_internal: Shift: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Read Channels → Move Dial → Check Panel
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Read Channels → Move Dial → Check Panel
rituals.goal: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.mission: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.challenge: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.immediate_need: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Read Channels — Read three channels without searching your whole body: SPEED, PRESSURE, and TEMPERATURE. Use lower, medium, or high. Disassemble Alarm — widen gaze.
2. Pick Smallest — Choose the safest channel with the lowest intensity. Do not pick the loudest one.
3. Move Dial — Move only that channel one step: slow one hand movement, soften one contact point, or adjust one safe layer of warmth or coolness. Disassemble Alarm — name sensation.
4. Check Panel — Check whether that channel changed at all. Let the other two channels remain exactly as they are. Disassemble Alarm — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Check Panel.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.formula_flow: Read Channels → Pick Smallest → Move Dial → Check Panel
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
New, severe, or unusual physical symptoms require medical assessment. Stop for pain, faintness, breathing difficulty, confusion, or loss of orientation.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.goal: A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.
rituals.mission: A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.
rituals.challenge: A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.
rituals.immediate_need: A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Scan Objects — Choose four safe visible objects without moving toward them. Avoid screens if they add strain. Room Has — breathe naturally.
2. Name Jobs — For each object, name only its ordinary job: chair supports, lamp lights, cup holds, door opens.
3. Drop Demands — Say ‘not needed now’ to every function that does not serve the current safe moment. Do not remove or organise anything. Room Has — pick action.
4. Choose Helper — Choose the one object whose real function supports the next action, then use only that function. Room Has — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Helper.

rituals.hook: Flip: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Run Pulse → Read Strain → Set Gear

rituals.goal: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
rituals.mission: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
rituals.challenge: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
rituals.immediate_need: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Run Pulse — Choose one ordinary task and run it for exactly thirty seconds without trying to finish it. Find Working — move slowly.
2. Full Stop — Stop completely for fifteen seconds. Hands off, eyes away, and no planning the next move.
3. Read Strain — Rate actual strain as light, workable, heavy, or stop. Compare it with what you predicted before starting. Find Working — pick action.
4. Set Gear — Choose the next gear—30/15, 60/30, or stop—and complete exactly one more cycle at that ratio. Find Working — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Set Gear.

✓ Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.

rituals.name: HARVEST THE PROOF OF PROGRESS
rituals.hook: Shift: Gains must be stored before motivation can spend them.
rituals.hook_internal: Shift: Gains must be stored before motivation can spend them.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Create Prior → Date Examples → Choose Action
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Create Prior → Date Examples → Choose Action
rituals.goal: Gains must be stored before motivation can spend them.
rituals.mission: Gains must be stored before motivation can spend them.
rituals.challenge: Gains must be stored before motivation can spend them.
rituals.immediate_need: Gains must be stored before motivation can spend them.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Gains must be stored before motivation can spend them.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Create Prior — Collect three concrete differences created by prior effort—speed, quality, recovery time, knowledge, frequency, distance. Harvest Proof — widen gaze.
2. Date Examples — Attach dates or examples. Harvest Proof — pick action.
3. Choose Action — Select the next action that becomes reasonable because one difference now exists. Harvest Proof — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Action.

rituals.name: FIVE CLUES MAY BE ONE CLUE
rituals.ritual_name: FIVE CLUES MAY BE ONE CLUE
rituals.hook: Aim: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
rituals.hook_internal: Aim: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Clues → Collapse Copies → Recheck Claim
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Name Clues → Collapse Copies → Recheck Claim
rituals.goal: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
rituals.mission: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
rituals.challenge: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
rituals.immediate_need: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Clues — Name up to five clues currently supporting the worried conclusion. Five Clues — soften shoulders.
2. Link Sources — Imagine a line between clues that came from the same person, event, article, assumption, mood, or repeated retelling.
3. Collapse Copies — Collapse every linked cluster into one source family; do not count its echoes separately. Five Clues — notice detail.
4. Recheck Claim — Recheck the claim using the number and quality of independent families that remain. Five Clues — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Recheck Claim.

rituals.name: THE LAST-DAY FILTER
rituals.hook: Try: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
rituals.hook_internal: Try: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Imagine Back → Remain Relationship → Give Surviving
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Imagine Back → Remain Relationship → Give Surviving
rituals.goal: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
rituals.mission: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
rituals.challenge: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
rituals.immediate_need: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urgency & decision pressure

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Back — Imagine looking back from life’s end—not to frighten yourself, but to rank. Last Day — loosen hands.
2. Demand — Which current demand disappears?
3. Remain Relationship — Which relationship, integrity choice, health need, or contribution remains?. Last Day — pick action.
4. Give Surviving — Give the surviving priority one concrete slot today. Last Day — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Give Surviving.

✓ Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.

rituals.title: ROTATE THE OBSERVATION DECK
rituals.name: ROTATE THE OBSERVATION DECK
rituals.hook: Flip: Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.
rituals.hook_internal: Flip: Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Observe Moment → Spot Amplifier → Choose Position
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Observe Moment → Spot Amplifier → Choose Position
rituals.goal: Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.
rituals.mission: Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.
rituals.challenge: Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.
rituals.immediate_need: Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Observe Moment — Observe the same moment from three positions: body-centred, environment-centred, and whole-field. Rotate Observation — move slowly.
2. Spot Amplifier — Keep what each amplifies and hides. Rotate Observation — notice detail.
3. Choose Position — Choose the position best suited to the upcoming task rather than declaring any one neutral. Rotate Observation — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Position.

rituals.name: THE MILLISECOND BEFORE THE NAME
rituals.hook: Zoom: What you notice exists briefly before concept files it.
rituals.hook_internal: Zoom: What you notice exists briefly before concept files it.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Look Touch → Don't Freeze → Repeat Sound

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
What you notice exists briefly before concept files it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Look Touch — Look at or touch something ordinary. Millisecond Before — loosen hands.
2. Catch Bare — Catch the first bare instant before ‘cup,’ ‘cold,’ ownership, or preference appears.
3. Don't Freeze — Do not freeze it; simply recognise the order: contact, then concept. Millisecond Before — notice detail.
4. Repeat Sound — Repeat with a sound. Millisecond Before — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Repeat Sound.

rituals.title: MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS
rituals.name: MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS
rituals.hook: Check: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.hook_internal: Check: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: State Rule → Compare Effects → Keep Core
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: State Rule → Compare Effects → Keep Core
rituals.goal: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.mission: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.challenge: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.immediate_need: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. State Rule — Picture the rule without naming who taught it. Move Rule — widen gaze.
2. Change Context — Place it in three contrasting settings—for example family, workplace, and friendship—with different power and consequences.
3. Compare Effects — Compare who is protected, restricted, or harmed in each setting. Move Rule — challenge answer.
4. Keep Core — Keep only the part that remains ethical and workable across contexts; Notice the rest as conditional. Move Rule — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Core.

rituals.hook: Imagine: A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Name Mind → Compare Progress → Group Exists
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Name Mind → Compare Progress → Group Exists
rituals.goal: A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.
rituals.mission: A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.
rituals.challenge: A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.
rituals.immediate_need: A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Mind — Name the group your mind selected. Change Comparison — feel support.
2. Match Resources — Substitute a baseline matched on starting point, resources, time, responsibilities, and opportunity.
3. Compare Progress — Compare progress with context included. Change Comparison — estimate odds.
4. Group Exists — If no fair group exists, use your own prior trajectory. Change Comparison — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Group Exists.

GOAL
Values can survive the absence of approval.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Safe — Perform a low-risk act you endorse and perform it without announcing, checking reactions, or fishing for reassurance. Do Good — breathe naturally.

items.hook: Try: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.

items.game_move: PLAY: Choose Charged → Listen Moment → Return Seen

items.goal: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
items.mission: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
items.challenge: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
items.immediate_need: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Charged — Choose one charged word—not a whole painful story. Word Melt — loosen hands.
2. Say Gently — Say it gently and steadily for about twenty seconds.
3. Listen Moment — Listen for the moment it becomes rhythm, mouth movement, or noise. Word Melt — notice detail.
4. Stop Room — Stop there and look around the room.
5. Return Seen — Meaning may return; you have seen it separate once. Word Melt — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Return Seen.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Communication & conflict

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Read Bandwidth — Choose your current safe bandwidth: ONE SENTENCE, THREE SENTENCES, or FULL CONVERSATION. Set Conversation — loosen hands.
2. Choose Size — Name the purpose that must fit inside that size: acknowledge, request, pause, clarify, or repair.
3. Send Signal — Draft or say only the selected amount. Stop when the sentence limit is reached, even if more remains. Set Conversation — estimate odds.
4. Set Reopen — Name when or under what condition the next level can reopen. If you cannot offer one, state that honestly without making a false promise. Set Conversation — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Set Reopen.

✓ A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.

ENOUGH IS A CURRENT FACT

TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

GOAL
Sufficiency can coexist with ambition.

1. Identify Part — Spot one part of the present condition that is genuinely adequate: shelter, breath, effort, support, knowledge, or time for the next step. Enough Current — soften shoulders.
2. Receive Adequacy — Receive that adequacy without claiming everything is fine. Enough Current — notice detail.
3. Choose Non — From this base, choose one non-desperate improvement. Enough Current — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Non.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ Sufficiency can coexist with ambition.

FORMULA FLOW
Identify Part → Receive Adequacy → Choose Non

items.challenge: Give both positions a voice without claiming either is fact.

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Give both positions a voice without claiming either is fact.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Place Chairs — Place two chairs apart. Two Chairs — soften shoulders.
2. Speak Position — Speak from your position using first person.
3. Switch Chair — Move and answer as the other position, labelling imagination where knowledge is missing. Two Chairs — notice detail.
4. Return To Facts — Return to your chair and state what changed, what did not, and what real conversation may still be needed. Two Chairs — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Return To Facts.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I can give both positions a voice without claiming either is fact.
items.formula_flow: Place Chairs → Speak Position → Switch Chair → Return To Facts
items.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid this alone for traumatic relationships or if role-switching feels disorganising.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Disclosure should increase clarity, not steal control.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Trustworthy — Choose a trustworthy listener and agree on time, confidentiality, and a stop signal. Tell At — widen gaze.
2. Share — Share facts first, then feelings and meaning in tolerable detail.
3. Pause Orient — Pause to orient between sections. Tell At — allow opposite.
4. End Support — End with what support you want now—not what the listener guesses. Tell At — next action.

⚡ FINISH — End Support.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Rotate before one cue becomes background noise.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Select Different — Select four anchors from different systems: visual line, distant sound, contact pressure, joint position. Grounding Anchor — hear sound.
2. Switch Getting — Spend a short interval with each and switch before getting used to it empties it. Grounding Anchor — notice detail.
3. Finish Channel — Finish on the channel that restored the clearest present contact. Grounding Anchor — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Channel.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Read Channels — Read three channels without searching your whole body: SPEED, PRESSURE, and TEMPERATURE. Use lower, medium, or high. Disassemble Alarm — widen gaze.
2. Pick Smallest — Choose the safest channel with the lowest intensity. Do not pick the loudest one.
3. Move Dial — Move only that channel one step: slow one hand movement, soften one contact point, or adjust one safe layer of warmth or coolness. Disassemble Alarm — name sensation.
4. Check Panel — Check whether that channel changed at all. Let the other two channels remain exactly as they are. Disassemble Alarm — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Check Panel.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
items.formula_flow: Read Channels → Pick Smallest → Move Dial → Check Panel
items.safety:
PAUSE
New, severe, or unusual physical symptoms require medical assessment. Stop for pain, faintness, breathing difficulty, confusion, or loss of orientation.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

1. Picture Identity — Picture the identity Name on a removable Notice and turn it face down. Blank Nameplate — hear sound.
2. Decision — For the next decision, refer only to capacities, needs, facts, and values.
3. Choose Shift — Choose. Blank Nameplate — allow opposite.
4. Uncover Name — Then uncover the Name and compare what it would have predicted. Blank Nameplate — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Uncover Name.

items.hook: Switch: Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
items.hook_internal: Switch: Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
items.game_move: PLAY: Don't Recall → Simple → End Reclaim

items.mission: Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
items.challenge: Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
items.immediate_need: Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Ongoing sense can be sensed before the life story is consulted.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Don't Recall — For sixty seconds, do not recall name, history, status, or plans. Exist Minute — press feet.
2. Stay Changing — Stay with changing sound, pressure, light, and movement.
3. Simple — Notice the simple ongoing sense of being present through those changes. Exist Minute — allow opposite.
4. End Reclaim — Reclaim your biography on purpose at the end. Exist Minute — next action.

⚡ FINISH — End Reclaim.

items.hook: Catch: What someone did is not your identity property.

items.goal: What someone did is not your identity property.
items.mission: What someone did is not your identity property.
items.challenge: What someone did is not your identity property.
items.immediate_need: What someone did is not your identity property.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
What someone did is not your identity property.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Three Boxes — Imagine three boxes: THEIR BEHAVIOUR; WHAT I LEARNED; WHAT I CHOOSE NOW. Return Their — soften shoulders.
2. Keep Each Part — Keep each thought in the right box.
3. Do Not Force Forgiveness — Forgiveness is not required on command. Return Their — notice detail.
4. Act From Choice — Take one action from the third box. Return Their — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Act From Choice.

items.challenge: A boundary can close one door without burning down the whole house.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A boundary can close one door without burning down the whole house.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Contact — Name the contact pattern you want to change without judging the person. Down Door — press feet.
2. Pick Door — Choose exactly one access door: TIME, TOPIC, CHANNEL, LOCATION, or FREQUENCY.
3. Lower One — Lower that door by one clear level: shorter call, one topic excluded, text only, public place, or fewer contacts. Down Door — split duty.
4. Hold Setting — State the new setting and leave every other door unchanged for this round. Down Door — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Hold Setting.

✓ A boundary can close one door without burning down the whole house.
items.formula_flow: Name Contact → Pick Door → Lower One → Hold Setting

If there is abuse, stalking, coercion, violence, or immediate danger, prioritise safety planning and professional support over gradual access changes.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.goal: A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.

items.challenge: A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Scan Objects — Choose four safe visible objects without moving toward them. Avoid screens if they add strain. Room Has — breathe naturally.
2. Name Jobs — For each object, name only its ordinary job: chair supports, lamp lights, cup holds, door opens.
3. Drop Demands — Say ‘not needed now’ to every function that does not serve the current safe moment. Do not remove or organise anything. Room Has — pick action.
4. Choose Helper — Choose the one object whose real function supports the next action, then use only that function. Room Has — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Helper.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.
items.formula_flow: Scan Objects → Name Jobs → Drop Demands → Choose Helper
items.safety:

Stop for visual pain, dizziness, nausea, disorientation, compulsive scanning, or any real emergency requiring immediate action.

items.goal: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.

items.challenge: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
items.immediate_need: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Run Pulse — Choose one ordinary task and run it for exactly thirty seconds without trying to finish it. Find Working — move slowly.
2. Full Stop — Stop completely for fifteen seconds. Hands off, eyes away, and no planning the next move.
3. Read Strain — Rate actual strain as light, workable, heavy, or stop. Compare it with what you predicted before starting. Find Working — pick action.
4. Set Gear — Choose the next gear—30/15, 60/30, or stop—and complete exactly one more cycle at that ratio. Find Working — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Set Gear.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Meaning needs a recurring appointment.
items.play_the_loop:

items.name: FIVE CLUES MAY BE ONE CLUE
items.ritual_name: FIVE CLUES MAY BE ONE CLUE
items.hook: Aim: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
items.hook_internal: Aim: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
items.game_move: PLAY: Name Clues → Collapse Copies → Recheck Claim
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Name Clues → Collapse Copies → Recheck Claim
items.goal: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
items.mission: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
items.challenge: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
items.immediate_need: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Clues — Name up to five clues currently supporting the worried conclusion. Five Clues — soften shoulders.
2. Link Sources — Imagine a line between clues that came from the same person, event, article, assumption, mood, or repeated retelling.
3. Collapse Copies — Collapse every linked cluster into one source family; do not count its echoes separately. Five Clues — notice detail.
4. Recheck Claim — Recheck the claim using the number and quality of independent families that remain. Five Clues — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Recheck Claim.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.
items.formula_flow: Name Clues → Link Sources → Collapse Copies → Recheck Claim
items.safety:
PAUSE
Do not collapse separate danger signs or ignore qualified medical, legal, financial, or safety evidence.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

items.play_the_loop:
1. Find Anchor — Search only within the next twenty-four hours for one person, place, promise, task, or act that matters. Local Reason — breathe naturally.
2. Name Reason — Name why it matters locally. Local Reason — name feeling.
3. Invest Time — Give it ten minutes of undivided behaviour. Local Reason — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Invest Time.

items.name: THE LAST-DAY FILTER
items.hook: Try: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
items.hook_internal: Try: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
items.game_move: PLAY: Imagine Back → Remain Relationship → Give Surviving
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Imagine Back → Remain Relationship → Give Surviving
items.goal: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
items.mission: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
items.challenge: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
items.immediate_need: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urgency & decision pressure

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Back — Imagine looking back from life’s end—not to frighten yourself, but to rank. Last Day — loosen hands.
2. Demand — Which current demand disappears?
3. Remain Relationship — Which relationship, integrity choice, health need, or contribution remains?. Last Day — pick action.
4. Give Surviving — Give the surviving priority one concrete slot today. Last Day — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Give Surviving.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.
items.formula_flow: Imagine Back → Demand → Remain Relationship → Give Surviving
items.safety:
PAUSE
Skip mortality reflection when it intensifies anxiety, grief, or self-harm thoughts.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.goal: Let task feedback lead while self-opinion becomes background sound.
items.mission: Let task feedback lead while self-opinion becomes background sound.
items.challenge: Let task feedback lead while self-opinion becomes background sound.
items.immediate_need: Let task feedback lead while self-opinion becomes background sound.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Let task feedback lead while self-opinion becomes background sound.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Skill — Choose one familiar, low-risk task with clear external feedback. Put Commentator — breathe naturally.
2. Centre Feedback — Put sight, touch, sound, or the work result in the centre of attention.
3. Demote Voice — When self-commentary appears, let it continue faintly at the edge without answering or silencing it. Put Commentator — estimate odds.
4. Finish Unit — Finish one complete task unit using feedback—not self-opinion—to make corrections. Put Commentator — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Finish Unit.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

items.play_the_loop:
1. Observe Moment — Observe the same moment from three positions: body-centred, environment-centred, and whole-field. Rotate Observation — move slowly.
2. Spot Amplifier — Keep what each amplifies and hides. Rotate Observation — notice detail.
3. Choose Position — Choose the position best suited to the upcoming task rather than declaring any one neutral. Rotate Observation — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Position.

items.title: MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS
items.name: MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS
items.hook: Check: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
items.hook_internal: Check: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
items.game_move: PLAY: State Rule → Compare Effects → Keep Core
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: State Rule → Compare Effects → Keep Core
items.goal: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
items.mission: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
items.challenge: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
items.immediate_need: A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
items.play_the_loop:
1. State Rule — Picture the rule without naming who taught it. Move Rule — widen gaze.
2. Change Context — Place it in three contrasting settings—for example family, workplace, and friendship—with different power and consequences.
3. Compare Effects — Compare who is protected, restricted, or harmed in each setting. Move Rule — challenge answer.
4. Keep Core — Keep only the part that remains ethical and workable across contexts; Notice the rest as conditional. Move Rule — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Core.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
items.formula_flow: State Rule → Change Context → Compare Effects → Keep Core
items.safety:
PAUSE
Stop if the comparison turns into contempt for people or excuses unsafe or unlawful behaviour.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.
